notes: PARTIAL (2026-11-16, the 1985 code reads, cause b: wrong the same way at every edition): the mechanism of kb/Work PB5808: PB5808 - a USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure may change a control data item through a REDEFINES of it (every edition). Owner: kb/Work PB5808 (open). Ruled in kb/Work/PB5683/2026-11-15-rulings-code-reads-batch-4.md; the 1985 rows that carry into this rule: 1985-SR-XIII.4.9.3-4. Recorded by the registrar from the ruling and its note, the repro not re-run by the registrar. The prose that follows is the stored CONFORMS account, kept as the account of the part that holds. || kb/Work PB363 LANDED. Every statement bound in a USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure is asked, in BindStatement, whether the emitter-verified store classification (BoundStores.StoresInto, the generated exhaustive visitor) stores into any report's control data item, a group containing one, or an item subordinate to one; COBOL2378, one diagnostic per store (a nested statement reports at its own position and suppresses its container's). A BY REFERENCE CALL argument / INVOKE write-back is not counted: whether the callee alters it is not decidable from the source element. Residual not claimed: a store through a REDEFINES alias of a record that holds the control item is not related to it (the hierarchy test only) - a narrower-than-rule reading that never rejects legal source.
